protocol.name: unity_spatial_gestures_unstable
protocol.description: The unity-spatial-gestures plugin sends touchpad gestures with three or more fingers to the shell.

interface.name: zunity_spatial_gestures
interface.description: Sends touchpad gestures with three or more fingers to the client, wherever the pointer is. The client asks for each gesture that it uses. While an object for a gesture exists, the compositor sends that gesture only to that object, not to clients through zwp_pointer_gestures_v1. It sends all other gestures to clients as usual.

entry.name: invalid_kind
entry.summary: kind is not in the kind enum

description.summary: get the gestures of a kind with a number of fingers

interface.name: zunity_spatial_gesture

description.summary: touchpad gestures of one kind with one number of fingers

interface.description: The compositor sends one begin event, zero or more update events and one end event for each gesture.

event.name: update
event.description: For a swipe, scale is 1 and rotation is 0.

arg.name: scale
arg.summary: scale relative to the begin of a pinch

arg.name: rotation
arg.summary: rotation since the last update, in degrees clockwise

arg.name: cancelled
arg.summary: 1 if the touchpad cancelled the gesture, else 0
